stem: What is one way that Dylan in "A Book for Jonah" and Zach in "Fruit for All" are different?

options.label: F
options.text: Dylan has reached his original goal, but Zach is still working toward achieving his goal.

options.label: G
options.text: Dylan plans to write another book about chocolate, but Zach wants to limit the amount of fruit his group collects.

options.label: H
options.text: Dylan receives support from his community, but Zach receives support from his family.

options.label: J
options.text: Dylan’s idea resulted from wanting to help a friend, but Zach’s idea came from learning about other organizations.
